parole.testo: From Ladino בוריקאס (borekas)/borekas, plural of בוריקה (boreka)/boreka, from Turkic (compare Turkish börek).

parole.testo: According to Mordecai Rozen, borrowed from Ladino ספונג׳ה (spongia, “sponge”), from Latin spongia. Alternatively, Ruvik Rosenthal suggests it is a back-formation from Ladino ספונג׳אדור (“floor rag”).
